[{"proname":"export_my_verified_practice_history","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.export_my_verified_practice_history()\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  uid uuid := auth.uid();\n  snapshot jsonb;\n  document jsonb;\n  secret bytea;\nBEGIN\n  IF uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required'; END IF;\n  SELECT tradehq_private.portfolio_snapshot(uid) INTO snapshot;\n  IF snapshot IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'No account practice portfolio exists yet'; END IF;\n  SELECT signing_key INTO secret FROM tradehq_private.practice_export_keys WHERE key_id = 'v1';\n  IF secret IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Signing service unavailable'; END IF;\n  document := jsonb_build_object(\n    'format', 'tradehq-server-practice-history',\n    'version', 1,\n    'user_id', uid::text,\n    'issued_at', clock_timestamp(),\n    'nonce', encode(extensions.gen_random_bytes(16), 'hex'),\n    'snapshot', snapshot\n  );\n  IF pg_column_size(document) > 2000000 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account practice history exceeds export limit';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'payload', document, 'key_id', 'v1',\n    'signature', encode(extensions.hmac(convert_to(document::text, 'UTF8'), secret, 'sha256'), 'hex')\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n"},{"proname":"get_my_account_practice_snapshot","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_account_practice_snapshot()\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  uid uuid := auth.uid();\nBEGIN\n  IF uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required'; END IF;\n  RETURN tradehq_private.portfolio_snapshot(uid);\nEND;\n$function$\n"},{"proname":"get_public_practice_trades","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_public_practice_trades(p_username text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20)\n RETURNS TABLE(asset_id text, side text, quantity numeric, price numeric, fee numeric, total numeric, realized_pnl numeric, price_source text, created_at timestamp with time zone)\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n  SELECT t.asset_id, t.side, t.quantity, t.price, t.fee,\n         t.total, t.realized_pnl, t.price_source, t.created_at\n    FROM public.profiles AS pf\n    JOIN public.practice_portfolios AS pp ON pp.user_id = pf.id\n    JOIN public.practice_trades AS t ON t.user_id = pf.id AND t.cycle_id = pp.cycle_id\n   WHERE pf.username = p_username\n     AND pf.is_public IS TRUE\n     AND pf.show_public_trades IS TRUE\n   ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC\n   LIMIT GREATEST(1, LEAST(COALESCE(p_limit, 20), 20));\n$function$\n"},{"proname":"verify_my_practice_history_export","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.verify_my_practice_history_export(p_document jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  uid uuid := auth.uid();\n  payload jsonb;\n  sig text;\n  secret bytea;\n  calculated text;\nBEGIN\n  IF uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required'; END IF;\n  IF p_document IS NULL OR pg_column_size(p_document) > 2100000\n     OR jsonb_typeof(p_document) <> 'object' THEN\n    RETURN jsonb_build_object('verified', false, 'reason', 'Invalid document');\n  END IF;\n  payload := p_document->'payload';\n  sig := p_document->>'signature';\n  IF payload IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(payload) <> 'object'\n     OR payload->>'format' IS DISTINCT FROM 'tradehq-server-practice-history'\n     OR payload->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'\n     OR payload->>'user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM uid::text\n     OR p_document->>'key_id' IS DISTINCT FROM 'v1'\n     OR sig IS NULL OR sig !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN\n    RETURN jsonb_build_object('verified', false, 'reason', 'Wrong account or format');\n  END IF;\n  SELECT signing_key INTO secret FROM tradehq_private.practice_export_keys WHERE key_id = 'v1';\n  IF secret IS NULL THEN\n    RETURN jsonb_build_object('verified', false, 'reason', 'Verification unavailable');\n  END IF;\n  calculated := encode(extensions.hmac(convert_to(payload::text, 'UTF8'), secret, 'sha256'), 'hex');\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'verified', sig = calculated,\n    'reason', CASE WHEN sig = calculated\n      THEN 'Issued by TradeHQ for this account; historical snapshot only'\n      ELSE 'File content does not match its original server-issued signature' END\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n"}]
